decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (STGR-35BP (OS Map block plan), STGR-35RP (existing and proposed roof plans), STGR-35SP (OS Map site location plan), STGR-350 (existing ground floor plan), STGR-350P (proposed ground floor plan), STGR-355 (existing elevations) and STGR-355P (proposed elevations). Received 09/09/2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a single storey rear infill extension to the house.
